task_definition.task_description: Please check the current status of my main lock, then lock it using PIN 1234, and after that check its status again. Also get the latest technology news, sort the headlines in ascending order, and then create a Trip Summary document with the lock status before and after plus the sorted headlines, and send me an in-app alert with medium priority.

user_input.query: Please check the current status of my main lock, lock_main, then lock it using PIN 1234, and after that check its status again. Finally, send me an in-app alert with medium priority when it’s done. This is for user_001.
